messages:
alex: Observed p95 token latency jump on dedicated-eu-1 from ~180ms -> ~820ms at 2026-03-18T15:04Z. Requests queued, throughput drop. Suspect KV cache pressure + placement saturation. Any heads-up?

deploy-bot: [ALERT] pool=dedicated-eu-1 util=98% throttle=18% (15:05Z)

chris: Looking at placement logs — a bunch of allocation retries and kernel fallbacks. Quick grep below:
```
placement: allocate_slot pool=dedicated-eu-1 attempts=11 fail=quota_exceeded
kernel_select: chosen=int8 fallback=float32 reason=insufficient_workspace
kv_cache: eviction_count=8420 per_min=420
```

maya: KV cache miss rate jumped to 73% for that pool in the same window. Feels like noisy-tenant thrash — long-seq traffic causing continuous KV evictions.

irene: Oncall: customer-42 shows burstable=true with no per-pool hard cap; they had a big burst at 15:02 and used up soft-reservation. Quota remaining=0.

alex: Are retries pushing requests into placement queue without backpressure? I see many immediate requeues (no exponential backoff).

chris: Paste from scheduler logs:
```
placement_queue: reenqueue job_id=xyz backoff=0s retries=7
placement_decision: fail reason=quota_exceeded tenant=customer-42
```

maya: Profiler summary (sample):
```
cpu: kernel_selection +18ms
gpu_wait: kv_cache_miss_penalty +45ms
kv_cache: churn_rate x20
```
Cache churn + kernel fallback explains latency tail.

alex: Temporary mitigation: applying soft limit to pool to cap bursts >20rps and set per-tenant hard cap. Command:
```
rtctl set-pool --pool dedicated-eu-1 --soft-limit-rps 20
rtctl set-tenant-cap --tenant customer-42 --pool dedicated-eu-1 --hard-cap-rps 25
```

chris: Applied. Also shifted ~12% traffic to dedicated-eu-2 and adjusted kernel-selection to prefer int8 where supported. Monitoring.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] routing-change executed: 12% traffic -> dedicated-eu-2

irene: Created INC-4821. Next steps: audit burst configs, add placement backpressure, investigate per-tenant KV cache isolation. Postmortem owner: maya.

maya: Follow-up plan: implement per-tenant LRU shards for KV cache to avoid global thrash, add early-exit in kernel selector when cache_miss_ratio > 0.5, and add placement backpressure to scheduler.

alex: Ack. Leaving oncall to watch for 30m. If no new spikes, will close incident. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
